title: Dorsal Foot Stroking
summary: Very light passes are made between bony and tendon structures on the top of the foot.
goal: Gently work the top of the foot.
instructions: Place the fingers on the top of the foot.
Move from toes toward the ankle.
Do not press on ankle bones.
warning: Do not massage with recent injury, marked swelling, ulcers, infection, severe pain, or impaired sensation unless medically advised.
